name: Scarab Dais
summary: Northwest of the Scarab Wall, the Scarab Dais holds the Scarab Gong in southern Silithus. The gong is tied to the wards that seal the qiraji within Ahn'Qiraj.

sections.title: The Gong of Ahn'Qiraj
sections.body: Before the Scarab Wall, the Scarab Dais overlooks the sands where Ahn'Qiraj was sealed a millennium ago. The Scarab Gong rests on its stone platform, forged during the War of the Shifting Sands. Ancient night elven history and the bronze dragonflight say only the reconstructed Scepter of the Shifting Sands can break the magical barrier when it strikes the gong. Until then, horrors remain sealed beyond the wall.

faq.answer: The Scarab Dais is a stone ceremonial terrace in southern Silithus, northwest of the Scarab Wall. It was built to house the Scarab Gong, which controls the magical wards sealing Ahn'Qiraj.

faq.q: What happens if someone rings the gong on the dais?
faq.answer: Legend says striking the Scarab Gong with the restored Scepter of the Shifting Sands will shatter the wards across the Scarab Wall. The gates of Ahn'Qiraj will open, releasing the qiraji armies imprisoned within.

faq.q: Who watches over the Scarab Dais?
faq.answer: Jonathan the Revelator, a human Watcher of the bronze dragonflight and keeper of the Scarab Gong, watches over the gong and the sealed gate beyond from atop the dais.

angles.text: For the kaldorei, the Scarab Dais recalls the tragic War of the Shifting Sands a thousand years ago. Night elves and dragonflights paid in blood to seal the qiraji behind the wall.
